# Data Source: tfe_project

Gets information on a project.

~> **Note:** The `workspaceIds` and `workspaceNames` attributes are not guaranteed to return values in the same order, so they cannot be reliably mapped to one another. To map workspace names to IDs reliably, pass those names to the `tfeWorkspaceIds` data source.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as constructs from "constructs";
import * as cdktf from "cdktf";
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import * as tfe from "./.gen/providers/tfe";
class MyConvertedCode extends cdktf.TerraformStack {
  constructor(scope: constructs.Construct, name: string) {
    super(scope, name);
    new tfe.dataTfeProject.DataTfeProject(this, "foo", {
      name: "my-project-name",
      organization: "my-org-name",
    });
  }
}

```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the project.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) The name of the organization that the project belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `autoDestroyActivityDuration` (String) The duration after which the project will be auto-destroyed.
- `description` (String) The description of the project.
- `effectiveTags` (Map of String) A map of key-value tags associated with the project.
- `id` (String) The system-generated ID of the project.
- `workspaceIds` (Set of String) The IDs of the workspaces associated with the project.
- `workspaceNames` (Set of String) The names of the workspaces associated with the project.
